baseline.note: session-tier proxy; the orchestrator's typical session tier

held_quality: exact-match accuracy of the downshift arm >= baseline arm (deterministic verify; non-inferiority analog of the check_quality_regression.ts 0.48 win-rate threshold)
cost_metric: USD-weighted tokens: haiku 4.5 and sonnet share a 3x per-token price ratio (input $1 vs $3, output $5 vs $15 per MTok, 2026-07 Anthropic pricing) — cost_reduction = 1 - haiku_tokens / (3 * sonnet_tokens); claim passes at >= 0.30

slices.prompt: Count the lines that start exactly with '- [x]' in agents/roadmaps/road-to-cost-aware-model-routing.md. Answer with only the integer.
Count the directories directly inside src/skills/. Answer with only the integer.
What is the value of the 'model_tier:' frontmatter key in src/skills/file-editor/SKILL.md? Answer with only the value.
Count the lines that start exactly with '## ' in docs/CLAIMS.md. Answer with only the integer.
In src/scripts/_lib/model_tier.ts, what model does the TIER_TO_CLAUDE_MODEL map assign to the 'lite' tier? Answer with only the model name.
Count the lines that start exactly with 'export function' in src/scripts/_lib/subagent_steering.ts. Answer with only the integer.
Name the single file inside src/subagents/. Answer with only the filename.
How many lines does src/scripts/_lib/subagent_routing.ts have (wc -l)? Answer with only the integer.
Count the directories directly inside src/skills/ whose name starts with 'judge-'. Answer with only the integer.
What is the exact text of the first line (the '# ' heading) of src/agent-src/contexts/execution/subagent-steering.md, without the leading '# '? Answer with only that text.

negative_control.description: Open-ended synthesis slice ('propose an architecture restructuring of the orchestration layer') classified via inferSliceTier — must NOT resolve to lite; a control routed below the session tier fails the claim regardless of savings.
